state_vocabulary.BLOCKED: obligation cannot proceed; declared for completeness and unused at P0
state_vocabulary.DEFERRED_WITH_OWNER: binding=deferred; owner, future stage, observable disposition and evidence obligation recorded
state_vocabulary.MAPPED: binding=test; exactly one frozen planned node exists and the requirement maps to it one-to-one
state_vocabulary.PASS: reserved; zero PASS claims are permitted in P0
state_vocabulary.PLANNED: binding=static or attestation; obligation accepted at P0, and no node is applicable because verification is a named static check or an operator attestation
